properties.name: Reasoning crosses designs: a premise naming a record in another design carries that record's truth and proof status, and a change walk continues into designs that link to what it reached, at least within one hub
properties.source: @ajs, 2026-10-18, choosing B of the build list
properties.statement:
From the 2026-10-18 proof of concept (case 3: flo2-calc's primality decision citing a theorem proved in design ef749c7f6e03a853):
1. An xref stand-in used as a premise carries the far node's computed truth and proof status, not "no truth for a Resource".
2. A change walk that reaches a node continues into the designs that hold an xref to it, at least among a hub's members. boundary_crossings names them.
3. Stale or unreachable far ends read as such, never as holding.
Its home is reflow2 (the engine). flo2.io's hosting (which holds every hosted design in one process) is the natural assembler, so this needs a flo2 counterpart. Size: the largest of the build list.
